articles_en.title: David Ellison says HBO will air critical Elon Musk documentary despite his $1B investment in Skydance

articles_en.title: Elon Musk says: ‘I’m not MAGA’

articles_en.summary_zh: 伊隆·馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 在週三出席 Dealbook 峰會時表示，他不確定「MAGA」一詞的含義，並表示他在美國期中選舉期間花費這麼多錢，讓他覺得「很愚蠢」。

articles_en.title: Elon Musk says ousting Jensen Huang is like ‘kicking Michael Jordan off your team’

articles_en.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
articles_en.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.
